title: flutter/flutter
claim: flutter/flutter — Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
why_good: Google's cross-platform UI toolkit — a foundational framework, not an opening for a founder.
value: No startup wedge; the money around Flutter is services/consulting, and Google owns the platform.
risk: Owned by Google and already dominant; listed as an ecosystem signal, not a buildable opportunity.
